label: Hacker News — Freelancer? Seeking freelancer?
terms_note: Public API, no key, no rate limit; HN guidelines apply to posting (manual).

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** for reading (official Firebase API). Lane `human` → **api for search**, replies human. Confidence high.

endpoints.purpose: each SEEKING WORK / SEEKING FREELANCER comment

reference.limits: - No rate limit; no write API — replies are manual. - Public API, no key, no rate limit; HN guidelines apply to posting (manual).

adapter.rate_note: The API README states no rate limit. Two requests per second.

get_posting.note: GET /v0/item/<id>.json for one 'Freelancer? Seeking freelancer?' comment (ids are the monthly thread's kids[]). Comments have no title, so title and description both carry the HTML text; buyer is the poster's HN username; time (Unix) stays in raw. A missing item answers null (invalid_input).

not_offered.search_postings: Listing a month's posts takes two calls (GET /v0/user/whoishiring.json → submitted[] thread id, then GET /v0/item/<thread>.json → kids[]) plus one per comment; the API has no search endpoint and the adapter maps one call per verb.
not_offered.me: No credentials and no account endpoint (read-only public API).
not_offered.submit_bid: Replies are manual (HN has no write API).
